# CodePipelinePhaseDefinition

A phase of a code pipeline: a group of steps that runs once the phases it depends on have finished.

**Kind:** an object, used in requests and responses. In a request it is called `CodePipelinePhaseDefinitionInput`.

## In a request

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` |  | The phase's name, unique within the pipeline. |
| `dependsOn` | `string[] \| null` |  | The phases that must all finish successfully before this one starts. Null or empty: it can start straight away. |
| `steps` | [`CodePipelineStepDefinitionInput`](code-pipeline-step-definition.md#in-a-request)`[]` |  | The phase's steps. One agent's steps run one after another, in order; different agents' steps run in parallel unless a step's `dependsOn` says otherwise. |
| `preHook` | `string \| null` |  | The name of a hook (a Cogniscript method in the pipeline's hooks) to run before the phase's steps. |
| `postHook` | `string \| null` |  | The name of a hook to run after all the phase's steps finish. Often used to read step outputs and add phases or steps. |
| `onFailHook` | `string \| null` |  | The name of a hook to run when the phase fails. It returns JSON with a `decision`: `"continue"` marks the phase skipped and carries on, `"fail"` fails the run as usual. |
| `durationWarning` | `timespan \| null` |  | Not used by code pipeline runs. |
| `durationAutoTermination` | `timespan \| null` |  | The longest any step in this phase may run, for steps that set no `durationAutoTermination` of their own. Null: the pipeline's value applies. |
| `durationActivityTimeout` | `timespan \| null` |  | How long any step in this phase may go without activity before it is stopped, for steps that set no `durationActivityTimeout` of their own. Null: the pipeline's value applies. |

```json
{
  "name": "...",
  "dependsOn": [
    "..."
  ],
  "steps": [
    {

      "agentName": "...",
      "targetRole": "Architect",
```
